section-226A-2.TO: have regard to all the circumstances, including in particular the factors in subsection (3)
section-226A-2.IN: considering whether this section applies to a bulk personal dataset

section-226B-3.FOR: The head of an intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226B-3.WHERE: the conditions in subsections (4) and (5) are met

section-226B-7.TO: grant an individual authorisation from seeking the approval of a Judicial Commissioner
section-226B-7.IF: the person considers that it would be appropriate to seek such approval

section-226B-8.FOR: An individual authorisation relating to a bulk personal dataset (“dataset A”)
section-226B-8.TO: authorise the retention or examination of other bulk personal datasets (“replacement datasets”) that do not exist at the time of the grant of the authorisation but may reasonably be regarded as replacements for dataset A

section-226BA-2.FOR: The head of an intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226BA-2.WHERE: — (a) they consider that section 226A applies to any dataset that falls within the category of datasets described in the authorisation, and (b) the decision to grant the authorisation has been approved by a Judicial Commissioner

section-226BA-3.TO: describe a category of bulk personal datasets by reference to (among other things) the use to which the datasets will be put

section-226BB-1.TO: review the conclusions of the person who granted the authorisation as to the following matters— (a) in relation to an individual authorisation, whether section 226A applies to the bulk personal dataset described in the authorisation, and (b) in relation to a category authorisation, whether section 226A applies to any dataset that falls within the category of datasets described in the authorisation
section-226BB-1.IN: deciding whether to approve a decision to grant an individual authorisation or a category authorisation

section-226BB-2.TO: — (a) apply the same principles as would be applied by a court on an application for judicial review, and (b) consider the matters referred to in subsection (1) with a sufficient degree of care as to ensure that the Judicial Commissioner complies with the duties imposed by section 2 (general duties in relation to privacy)

section-226BB-3.TO: give the person who decided to grant the authorisation written reasons for the refusal
section-226BB-3.WHERE: the Judicial Commissioner refuses to approve a decision to grant an individual authorisation or a category authorisation

section-226BB-4.FOR: the head of the intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226BB-4.TO: ask the Investigatory Powers Commissioner to decide whether to approve the decision to grant the authorisation
section-226BB-4.WHERE: a Judicial Commissioner, other than the Investigatory Powers Commissioner, refuses to approve a decision to grant an individual authorisation or a category authorisation

section-226BC-2.FOR: The person who granted the authorisation
section-226BC-2.TO: inform a Judicial Commissioner that it has been granted

section-226BC-3.TO: — (a) decide whether to approve the decision to grant the authorisation, and (b) notify the person who granted the authorisation of the Judicial Commissioner’s decision
section-226BC-3.BEFORE: the end of the relevant period

section-226BC-6.FOR: The head of the intelligence service
section-226BC-6.TO: secure that anything in the process of being done in reliance on the authorisation stops as soon as possible

section-226CA-1.FOR: the head of an intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226CA-1.TO: renew an individual authorisation or a category authorisation
section-226CA-1.AT: any time during the renewal period
section-226CA-1.IF: the renewal conditions are met for the authorisation

section-226CB-1.FOR: The head of an intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226CB-1.TO: cancel an individual authorisation or a category authorisation

section-226CB-2.FOR: the head of an intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226CB-2.IF: they consider that any of the cancellation conditions are met in relation to an individual authorisation, or that the cancellation condition is met in relation to a category authorisation

section-226CC-2.FOR: The head of the intelligence service, or a person acting on their behalf
section-226CC-2.TO: decide to grant a new individual authorisation (see section 226B) to retain, or to retain and examine, any material retained by the intelligence service in reliance on the authorisation which has ceased to have effect
section-226CC-2.BEFORE: the end of the period of 5 working days beginning with the day on which the authorisation ceases to have effect

section-226D-2.FOR: The head of the intelligence service
section-226D-2.TO: secure that anything in the process of being done in relation to that part of the bulk personal dataset in reliance on the authorisation stops as soon as possible

section-226DA-1.FOR: The head of each intelligence service
section-226DA-1.TO: provide an annual report to the Secretary of State about the bulk personal datasets that were authorised under this Part to be retained, or retained and examined, by the intelligence service during the period to which the report relates

section-226DA-2.TO: relate to a period of at least one year and no more than two years, beginning with the day on which this Part comes fully into force

section-226DA-3.TO: relate to a period of no more than one year, beginning with the end of the period to which the previous report related

section-226DA-4.TO: be provided to the Secretary of State
section-226DA-4.AS SOON AS: reasonably practicable after the end of the period to which the report relates

section-226DB-1.TO: for each relevant period provide to the Intelligence and Security Committee of Parliament a report setting out information about category authorisations and renewals of category authorisations granted in that period

section-226DB-3.AS SOON AS: reasonably practicable after the end of the period to which the report relates

section-226DC-3.FOR: only a person holding office under the Crown
section-226DC-3.TO: For the purposes of this Part, act on behalf of the head of an intelligence service
